name: google
description: Google developer platforms with live docs: the Google Developer Knowledge MCP (developer.android.com, developer.chrome.com, web.dev, Firebase, Google Cloud) plus two skills — android-compose (Android/Kotlin/Compose, Gradle/AGP 9, Nav 3, testing, performance, widgets, Media3) and chrome-web (MV3 extensions, Web Store publishing, Baseline web platform APIs).

interface.longDescription: Android/Kotlin/Compose and Chrome/web work in any repo. The Google Developer Knowledge MCP server searches current developer.android.com, developer.chrome.com, web.dev, Firebase and Google Cloud docs. android-compose reads the repo first and routes to focused references (architecture, Gradle/AGP 9, Nav 3, testing, performance, R8, security, widgets, Media3); chrome-web covers Manifest V3 runtime traps, Web Store publishing, Baseline-aware web APIs, a static MV3 checker and headless Chromium extension tests. Personal toolkit maintained by travnie; not an official Google plugin.
